music.name: 碓氷悠一朗(塚越雄一朗)

other.name: 碓氷悠一朗(塚越雄一朗)

segments.text: Kotarou's classmate and childhood friend. They can easily establish a comic rhythm in their dialogue. She is very talented at caring for herbs and plants.
瑚太朗の大親友。 小さくて元気いっぱい、小動物っぽい女の子。
ガーデニングの才能と霊感がある。
昔からいつも瑚太朗と一緒に行動していたせいか、友達は少ない。
持ち前のノリの良さで、瑚太朗とは漫才のようなノリの会話を繰り広げている。
瑚太朗的好朋友。身材娇小但精力充沛、像小动物一样的女孩子。
园艺方面很有才能并持有灵感。
因为从以前开始就一直和瑚太朗在一起、所以没什么朋友。
天性迷糊，总是和瑚太朗进行着像相声一样的迷糊对话。

Kotarou's kouhai. She has a reserved and honest disposition. Even if she doesn't speak, she is able to convey herself through her behavior; she has rich facial expressions. Although a member of the Disciplinary Committeee, she rarely acts like one, besides as a pretext for looking after Kotarou. She fawns over her favorite dish, saury.
瑚太朗の後輩で、風紀委員会に所属している。
無口で素直な性格。 言葉がなくても振る舞いで伝わる、感情表現の豊かな少女。
あまり風紀の活動を行わないが、瑚太朗に構ってほしくて取締りをすることがある。
眼帯はオッドアイを隠すためのもので、親しい人の前でしか外すことはない。
さんまが好物で溺愛している。
主人公的后辈、风纪委员会所属。无口但很直率。
虽然不怎么说话但会通过行动来表达、感情表现很丰富的少女。
几乎没像样地做过风纪委员的工作、为了让瑚太朗注意自己而对他进行监管。
为了隐瞒自己的虹彩异色症而戴着眼罩、只有在亲近的人面前才会拿下。
非常喜欢吃秋刀鱼。
The president of the Occult Research Society who is called the "witch of the academy". Within the school, she is famous among some of the students for being an existence above the rules.
“学園の魔女” と噂されるオカルト研究会の部長。
校内では超法規的な存在として一部生徒には有名。
儚げな外面だが、瑚太朗以上に人を食った性格と微妙に地味な内面を持つ。
何か裏のありそうな言動が目立つが、その実態は誰も知らない。
被暗地里称作「学园的魔女」的神秘研究会部长。
在校内是个我行我素的人在部分学生中很有名。
和外表不相称的是比瑚太朗更喜欢捉弄人、内心深处也有着朴实的一面的少女。
似乎为了什么目的一举一动都很引人注目、真正的目的谁也无从知晓。

The talented class president whose name is also well-known to surrounding clubs. With a clean-freak attitude, she strongly lacks tolerance when dealing with boys. As a result of getting rolled up in commotion caused by Kotarou, she delivers him daily punishment.
Her real name is Asahi Haruka(アサヒ・ハルカ).
周囲のクラスにもその名が知れ渡るカリスマクラス委員長。
潔癖症気味で男子に対する免疫が極端にない。
瑚太朗の起こす騒動によく巻き込まれ、結果瑚太朗に制裁を加える日々を送る。
凛とした態度と辛い物好きで周囲にはお馴染みだが、本人はあまり目立つのは苦手。

A girl who suddenly transferred to the school Kotarou attends. She has led a sheltered life and is ignorant of the ways of the world. Considerably clumsy and easily getting lost, Kotarou always helps her out, but with her personality that can't stay meek they can't stop quarreling. Called a "power fighter" for being really strong physically.
風祭高校に突然転校してきた少女。 世間知らずの箱入り娘で、パワーファイター。
かなりのドジっ子で瑚太朗に助けられてばかりだが、素直になれず口論が絶えない。
周りからは瑚太朗に気があるようにも本気で嫌っているようにも見える。
突然转学到瑚太朗所在学校的少女。
不知人间险恶的深闺大小姐、精力过剩的存在。
由于其过分天然呆的属性一直受到瑚太朗的帮助、但由于其别扭的性格总是和瑚太朗争论不休。
从周围人看来是又在意瑚太朗又很讨厌他的样子。
One of the two UMA Kotarou brought home from an alternate dimension. He and Pani have their own opposite personalities.
The rude man who confront Kotarou. He is a giant man with gyoza-like ears.
A resident of the slums, he has an aged look despite being so young. He gets really happy when someone calls him "Winter Fang". He is a gang member of the Yoshino Haruhiko's gang aka "Wolf Pack".
One of the shikigami who protects Kotarou at night.
The comrade of Kotarou during his military training trip to Brazil in Terra route.
A cool gentleman, but still a loving father to Kotori. Even now, he still falls head over heels for his wife. He's a member of the hunting club and now helps to exterminate animal pests.
When Kotori was young, he died in the car accident and turned into a familiar.
Edited from the Memories.
Kotori's mother. She just oozes nobility. She used to be a tsundere. Currently madly in love with her husband.
When Kotori was young, she died in the car accident and turned into a familiar.
Edited from Memories.
Midow's teammate and Gaia's summoner.
Midow's teammate and Gaia's summoner.
One of the shikigami who protects Kotarou at night. A loyal ally who cared about Kotarou.
The partially edited info is brought from Memories.
One of the shikigami who protects Kotarou at night. A loyal ally who cared about Kotarou.
The partially edited info is brought from Memories.
One of the shikigami who protects Kotarou at night. A loyal ally who cared about Kotarou.
The partially edited info is brought from Memories.
One of the shikigami who protects Kotarou at night. A loyal ally who cared about Kotarou.
The partially edited info is brought from Memories.
An old spirit, who breaks the fourth wall by telling Kotarou about autosaving the game.
An old lady who runs the candy shop for the years in Kazamatsuri.
The cafeteria lady who cares about the student patrons wisely and with understanding. She adds extra food to food-lovers and cuts down food to low-eaters.

The mature-adult-aged lead researcher, who organized genetical modification on Konohana Lucia, and also the lead researcher of the Guardian secret society. The former second-in-command of the old Next Generation Humanity Project.
She is the main antagonist of Lucia's route.
The lover and bodyguard of Kashima Sakura.
Kotarou's mother. She is a member of the Martel Group.
The younger sister of Nakatsu Shizuru.

segments.text: Often referred to as simply Gen, he owns a ramen shop Shizuru frequents. He is a strong man who is knowledgeable about what goes on in the city.
From Wikipedia
Sakura Kashima is an older woman who is the holy maiden of Martel. She is a skilled summoner and has a large hatred for humankind. She adopted Akane, but she doesn't give her last name.
In Harvest festa!, she gives Akane her last name.

Jasmine is a young, poor girl from a third-world country Kotarou meets while on a mission for Guardian in the Terra scenario. He stays in contact with her even after he leaves back to Kazamatsuri. She is instrumental in letting the world know about Gaia, Guardian and familiars via the Internet.
From Wikipedia

A bit brazen, getting carried away easily. While not aware of it himself, he's a somewhat meddlesome person. Perhaps because of poking his nose into others' affairs, he has recently gotten involved in inexplicable events.

Kotarou's loner classmate, a self-styled "outlaw" (the English word). The other students keep their distance from him, but Kotarou finds his gag-like speech patterns hilarious. Yoshino can't stand Kotarou's flippant and manipulative behavior, wishing to settle the score by fighting.
Main heroine of Rewrite. She is referred as the "key" throughout the game. The last two concluding arcs of the game called "Moon route" and "Terra route" revolve around her.
Midou is a hooded summoner in Gaia who becomes involved in attacking Kotarou with black demon dogs.
Kotori's pet dog that says "mosu mosu" as opposed to barking.
He real and birth name is Pero(ペロ). He was abused by his previous owner via cutting his ears and due to the abuse he didn't live long and later was resurrected by Kotori.

A gentleman who runs an antique shop business in the city of Kazamatsuri. After meeting Kotarou on a certain occasion, he grants him advice that draws from his vast life experience. Although calling himself a "totally humorous, somewhat mischievous businessman", his gags oppositely charm everyone with fear.
One of the two UMA Kotarou brought home from an alternate dimension. She and Gil have their own opposite personalities.
A mute girl under Akane's care. Gifted and acts like a younger version of Akane. She is about 7-8 years old.
Arata Imamiya is a playboy who dresses young for his age.

Inoue is a girl in the newspaper club at Kotarou’s school. She suspects that Kotarou’s bribed his way into being admitted to the school. Like Kotarou, she investigates the mysterious surrounding Kazamatsuri, and thus sees him as a rival.
While not illustrated in the game, she is later given official artwork in other media. Her official sprite appears in Harvest festa and Rewrite+.

Calls himself Chihaya's "older brother". While not related to her by blood, he takes care of various things in his stated role as butler. Taking the attitude of a serene older brother while facing Yoshino and the female students, for some reason he's coldhearted only to Kotarou. With unusual physical ability and knowledge, while having strange connections he puts on a display of calmly providing anything, as a flawless butler.

He is a former Rewrite user as same as Kotarou, who became into a familiar due to overuse of Rewrite ability. His surname is Ootori, because he has formed familiar-master contract with Chihaya, despite not being as a blood or even adoptive brother.

A new teacher at the school Kotarou attends. With a lightly thoughtless personality, she has high popularity among both male and female students. An always smiling, amiable teacher, but she tends to dote on Shizuru who she has been acquainted with since before her present appointment.
